stories.title: Zverev Wins 2026 US Open Men's Final Over Shelton

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Zverev wins the 2026 US Open.

Def. Shelton 6-3, 7-6(2), 5-7, 6-2. Second Grand Slam title of the year (also won Roland Garros). H2H now 6-0.

America's 23-year men's Grand Slam drought continues.

#USOpen #Zverev #Tennis

- Won the 4th set on a 24-point rally
- 6-0 all-time vs. Shelton
- $7.67M prize money

Second Grand Slam winner of 2026. #USOpen #Tennis

stories.title: Rybakina Officially No. 1 as New WTA Rankings Released Monday

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Official: Elena Rybakina is WTA No. 1 as of today.

Ends Aryna Sabalenka's 99-week run at the top. Rybakina is the 30th player and first Kazakhstani to reach world No. 1. Leads the Race to WTA Finals by 1,007 points.
